summary: Frontend-only verification of the lazy-require fix for expo-notifications in /app/frontend/src/links/notifications.ts. All 4 request criteria PASS on the web preview (mobile viewport 375x667). (1) App launches cleanly on Inbox — no red/white screen, Recall header + 'Capture' button + bottom tabs all render. (2) Browser console shows 0 matches for /expo-notifications.*Push notifications.*removed/i and 0 matches for /warnOfExpoGoPushUsage/i across console logs AND page errors (uncaught) during full session: load → Reminders tab → add-reminder-fab → save → Inbox → capture-button → composer → Archive → Settings. Total console logs captured: 3, error-level: 0, page errors (uncaught): 0. (3) Local reminder flow works end-to-end: tapped add-reminder-fab, filled reminder-title='Call dad', kept mode-time, tapped save-reminder → modal closed, 'Call dad' now visible in Upcoming list (verified via inner_text AND screenshot showing the reminder card with Thu, Oct 1 timestamp). No crash. (4) No regressions: capture-button opened /add composer (confirmed 'Something worth keeping' text), /archive renders, /settings renders with 'Expo Go' row visible. The lazy-require strategy is working as designed — on the web preview expo-notifications is only required when getNotifications() is invoked (by scheduleReminderNotification) and loads without triggering warnOfExpoGoPushUsage.
critical_code_review_comments: The console.error/console.warn regex patch in app/_layout.tsx (lines 18-28) is now largely redundant with the lazy-require fix in notifications.ts — on Expo Go Android the module is never required, and on web/dev-builds it loads cleanly. Consider removing the console override to avoid masking any future unrelated errors matching the regex. Non-blocking.

Web only validates that (a) nothing else broke in the refactor and (b) no page error is thrown. For true Expo Go Android verification, physical device testing via QR code is required. rca_of_issue: Root cause: expo-notifications' DevicePushTokenAutoRegistration.fx.js invokes warnOfExpoGoPushUsage() at import time on Expo Go Android (SDK 53+), which THROWS rather than warns, bypassing any console.error patch. Fix (verified correct in code): refactor notifications.ts to use require() behind lazy getters guarded by `isExpoGoAndroid = Platform.OS==='android' && Constants.executionEnvironment===ExecutionEnvironment.StoreClient`. On Expo Go Android getNotifications() returns null without ever requiring the module, so the throwing side effect never runs. On web and dev builds the require happens on-demand and succeeds. The top-level task-manager/defineTask block is also guarded by the same flag. Web preview run captured 0 uncaught errors across the full user flow — fix is sound and the request criteria are satisfied.
